I.9      Original normalized modularity for the private 214 construction
Source: research/quartic214/proofs/modularity.md.

        Final author revision after the first freeze. Author: /root/d214_modularity_closure, internal Sol
        author lane, 11 November 2026. Author proposal; no independent acceptance. The frozen private
        repository is bfeb8400982c9a169e4fdd39fb68ec053621e8ed. Sources and consumers are byte-bound in
        SOURCE_USES.json. INITIAL_AUTHOR_ANALYSIS.json records the actual order of exposure, including
        the scope summary read before reconstruction. This is an additive proof: no historical argument, verdict,
        count or polynomial is changed.


I.9.1      M0 . Exact input and conclusion
For every rational a = u/v in the domain of private height/PROOF.md H0 , retain its original
full-three-marked normalizer surface A = Aa , normal field L, and B-linear conjugate isogenies µσ .
In the non-CM case the geometric endomorphism algebra is the division quaternion algebra B of
discriminant 210. All conjugate Hom groups are L-defined, µ1 = 1, and the choices are inflated from
Gal(L/Q). These are geometric input assertions, not consequences of the modularity theorem. Put
T = supp(R), R = BS MS (a), and U = max({2} ∪ {2v2 (p−1) : oddp|R}).
    The claims established below, conditional only on those exact geometric inputs and the source
applications individually identified here, are: the new minimal-character lift gives genuine original
representations rℓ ; the same final normalized primitive weight-two f realizes r5 and r3 ; its actual
level satisfies N ≤ 268 316 516 74 R2 and rad(N )|R; and the multiplicity and character estimates of
H1–H2 hold over the actual L′ . The exact H01 geometric/metric/CM and retained conductor-source
transport is supplied by GEOMETRY_CARRY.md and PROVIDER_SCOPE_CARRY.md. These additive
comparisons require the same current nonauthor review; H3’s Rémond inequality and the full214
assembly are separate.
    Use covariant rational Tate modules, arithmetic Frobenius, and HT (Qℓ (1)) = −1. Added
algebraic coefficients have trivial Galois action. The names χ, b, ϵsign , ϵf , δ and the cyclotomic
character κ are distinct.
